item.title: Severe weather threat over in The Wiregrass, briefly getting cooler
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) — Conditions are improving across The Wiregrass after Thursday morning's storm system brought strong winds, possible tornadoes, and reports of damage. The strong line that produced the severe weather is now well off to our east, but some light to moderate rainfall will linger until about 10 a.m. for our eastern counties. [...]
